beat2p52SoftOctave.source:
dsp GenBeat2p52SoftOctave where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state o : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set b0 := fract(b0 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + (0.0 - 1.25)) / sr))
    set b1 := fract(b1 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 1.25) / sr))
    set o := fract(o + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((softsign(sinpi(b0 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0)) + softsign(sinpi(b1 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0)) + sinpi(o * 2.0) * 0.4) * 0.5 * envA) * 0.9) * 0.6180

dsp GenBeat2p53SoftUnison where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state o : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set b0 := fract(b0 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + (0.0 - 2.5)) / sr))
    set b1 := fract(b1 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 0.0) / sr))
    set b2 := fract(b2 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 2.5) / sr))
    set o := fract(o + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((softsign(sinpi(b0 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0)) + softsign(sinpi(b1 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0)) + softsign(sinpi(b2 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0))) * 0.333333 * envA) * 0.9) * 0.6340

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state o : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    set o := fract(o + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 2.0 / sr))

    return softsign(((sinpi(b0 * 2.0) + sinpi(b1 * 2.0) + sinpi(o * 2.0) * 0.4) * 0.5 * envA) * 0.9) * 0.5824

dsp GenBeat62SoftOctave where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state o : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set b0 := fract(b0 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + (0.0 - 3.0)) / sr))
    set b1 := fract(b1 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 3.0) / sr))
    set o := fract(o + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((softsign(sinpi(b0 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0)) + softsign(sinpi(b1 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0)) + sinpi(o * 2.0) * 0.4) * 0.5 * envA) * 0.9) * 0.6394

dsp GenBeat63SoftUnison where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state o : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set b0 := fract(b0 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + (0.0 - 6.0)) / sr))
    set b1 := fract(b1 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 0.0) / sr))
    set b2 := fract(b2 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 6.0) / sr))
    set o := fract(o + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((softsign(sinpi(b0 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0)) + softsign(sinpi(b1 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0)) + softsign(sinpi(b2 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 3.0))) * 0.333333 * envA) * 0.9) * 0.6498
